summary.headline: Royal Fortune from the Ascendant
summary.text: Astrological judgments about the lord of the ascendant: applications by square, opposition, trine, or sextile indicate varying relations with kings, while conjunction with the Sun, placement in the midheaven, and application to luminaries or their lords signify royal service, honor, and advantage according to reception.
